description.blurb: S/2006 S 12 is a natural satellite of Saturn, belonging to the Gallic group. It was discovered in 2006 and announced in 2023.
description.more: S/2006 S 12 is about 4 kilometers in diameter and orbits Saturn at an average distance of 19.6 million km in 1035.05 days. It has an inclination of 38.6° to the ecliptic in a prograde direction with an eccentricity of 0.542.
